tldr: 輝達財報超預期、盤後股價卻小跌，但 AI 基礎建設題材仍帶動亞洲股市改寫紀錄。
台股暴漲 1,347 點（+3.37%）收 41,368 點，創史上第五大單日漲點。
賴清德總統公布每年 2,000 億元育兒津貼與千億元振興中小企業計畫，引發財政壓力疑慮。
全球債市同步遭拋售、原油庫存創史上最大降幅，利率與中東風險仍是市場焦點。

items.title_zh: 台股暴漲 1,347 點收 41,368 點 創史上第五大漲點
items.title_en: TAIEX surges 1,347 points to 41,368 in fifth-largest gain on record
items.summary_zh: 台股周四（21 日）一掃陰霾強勢反攻，終場大漲 1,347.39 點、漲幅 3.37%，收在 41,368.31 點，創台股史上第五大單日漲點，成交量放大至 1.1 兆元。輝達財報優於預期、加上美伊衝突有望降溫，利多齊發點燃買盤。聯發科出關亮燈漲停助攻，AI 題材股全面發揮，波若威、前鼎等矽光（光通訊）概念股攻上漲停。本波反彈收復近期失土，顯示本土投資人風險偏好明顯回升。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark index roared back on Thursday, jumping 1,347.39 points or 3.37% to close at 41,368.31, its fifth-biggest single-day point gain ever, with turnover swelling to NT$1.1tn. The rally was fuelled by NVIDIA's better-than-expected earnings and hopes of a de-escalation in the US–Iran conflict. MediaTek resumed trading and hit limit-up, while AI-themed stocks led broadly; silicon-photonics names such as Browave and Chyn Tec hit their daily ceilings. The session erased recent losses and signalled renewed risk appetite among local investors.

items.title_zh: 國巨陳泰銘躍居台灣首富 擠下郭台銘
items.title_en: Yageo's Pierre Chen overtakes Terry Gou as Taiwan's richest
items.summary_zh: 國巨董事長陳泰銘登上台灣首富。國巨＊股價再度亮燈漲停至 572 元，續創分割後新高，帶動這家被動元件廠市值衝上 1.18 兆元，躍居台股第 12 大個股，也讓陳泰銘身家超越鴻海創辦人郭台銘、登上富豪榜首。此一變化凸顯被動元件與 AI 供應鏈個股今年大幅重估，獲利向少數族群集中，重新洗牌台灣富豪排行。
items.summary_en: Yageo chairman Pierre Chen has become Taiwan's wealthiest person after shares of Yageo* hit limit-up again at NT$572, a fresh post-spin-off high that lifted the passive-component maker's market value to NT$1.18tn — the 12th largest on the Taiwan exchange. The surge displaced Hon Hai founder Terry Gou at the top of the wealth ranking. The move underscores how component and AI-supply-chain plays have re-rated sharply this year, concentrating gains and reshaping Taiwan's billionaire league table.

items.title_zh: 大摩升評聯電 目標價上看 200 元
items.title_en: Morgan Stanley upgrades UMC with NT$200 target on mature-node revival
items.summary_zh: 摩根士丹利調升晶圓代工廠聯電評等，目標價上看 200 元，看好成熟製程需求重新轉強、招牌再度擦亮。大摩同時調整世界先進、環球晶等晶圓廠目標價，認為成熟製程正擺脫長期景氣下行循環。此次升評反映傳統晶片報價與產能利用率預期回穩，也為 AI 先進製程之外的台灣半導體族群增添法人偏多氛圍。
items.summary_en: Morgan Stanley has raised its rating on foundry UMC, lifting the price target to as high as NT$200 on signs that mature-process demand is regaining momentum. The brokerage also adjusted targets for wafer firms VIS (World Advanced) and GlobalWafers, arguing the mature-node segment is shaking off a prolonged downcycle. The upgrade reflects firmer pricing and capacity-utilisation expectations for legacy chips, and adds to the bullish institutional tone supporting Taiwan's semiconductor names beyond the AI leading edge.

items.title_zh: 集邦：2026 年 AI 伺服器出貨估增 28%
items.title_en: TrendForce projects 28% AI server shipment growth in 2026
items.summary_zh: 研究機構集邦科技（TrendForce）預估，2026 年全球 AI 伺服器出貨量將年增約 28%，此一成長步調正牽動鴻海、廣達等台灣主要系統整合廠的建廠布局。加速運算需求持續強勁，促使組裝廠擴充產能、重新調整製造據點。此預估強化市場對 AI 硬體上行循環仍有續航力的看法，也意味台灣伺服器供應鏈將持續是雲端巨頭資本支出的主要受惠者。
items.summary_en: Market intelligence firm TrendForce forecasts global AI server shipments will rise around 28% in 2026, a pace that is shaping factory build-out plans at leading Taiwanese system integrators including Hon Hai and Quanta. Sustained demand for accelerated computing is prompting assemblers to expand capacity and reconfigure their manufacturing footprints. The projection reinforces expectations that the AI hardware up-cycle has further room to run, and that Taiwan's server supply chain will remain a primary beneficiary of hyperscaler capital spending.

items.title_zh: 南亞科資本支出衝破 520 億元 估供不應求延續至 2027 年底
items.title_en: Nanya Technology raises capex past NT$52bn, sees tight supply into late 2027
items.summary_zh: 記憶體廠南亞科 21 日召開股東會，宣布資本支出將衝破 520 億元。董事長鄒明仁指出，AI 需求爆發已使記憶體產業從過去波動劇烈的傳統景氣循環，轉變為健康健全的結構性增長型態。總經理李培瑛表示，客戶目前積極搶料，預期供不應求將延續至 2027 年底。此一樂觀展望凸顯由 AI 伺服器與高頻寬記憶體帶動的記憶體上行循環，正重塑整個產業的長期投資布局。
items.summary_en: At its annual shareholders' meeting on Thursday, DRAM maker Nanya Technology said capital spending will exceed NT$52bn. Chairman Tsou Ming-jen argued that AI-driven demand has transformed the memory industry from its traditionally volatile boom-bust cycle into a healthier, structural-growth model. President Lee Pei-ying said customers are aggressively securing supply and expects the current shortage to persist into the end of 2027. The upbeat guidance highlights how the memory up-cycle, powered by AI servers and high-bandwidth memory, is reshaping long-term investment plans across the sector.

items.title_zh: 雙鴻擴產 AI 水冷散熱 看好 AI 旺到 2028 年
items.title_en: Auras expands liquid-cooling capacity as AI orders flood in
items.summary_zh: 散熱廠雙鴻 21 日召開股東會，董事長林育申表示，為因應 AI 伺服器蓬勃發展帶動的水冷散熱需求，雙鴻正全面擴充水冷板（cold plate）、分歧管（manifold）與均熱片產能。他指出 GPU 與 ASIC AI 伺服器需求同步暢旺，「有多少產能、客戶就下多少訂單」；ASIC 下半年逐步放量，營收比重上看四成。法人預估雙鴻今年營收有望年增 60～70%，林育申並樂觀看好 AI 題材「旺到 2028 年沒問題」。
items.summary_en: At its shareholders' meeting, Auras Technology chairman Lin Yu-shen said the company is fully expanding capacity for cold plates, manifolds and vapour chambers to meet booming AI-server liquid-cooling demand. Both GPU and ASIC AI servers are driving orders — "however much capacity we have, customers will order it" — with ASIC ramping in the second half and set to reach up to 40% of revenue. Analysts estimate Auras revenue could grow 60–70% this year, and Lin expects the AI cycle to stay strong "with no problem through 2028."

items.title_zh: 黃仁勳認了：中國 AI 市場已讓給華為
items.title_en: Huang concedes NVIDIA has ceded China's AI market to Huawei
items.summary_zh: 輝達執行長黃仁勳坦承，輝達實質上已將中國 AI 晶片市場拱手讓給華為，直言「我們已經退出那個市場」。此番談話反映美國出口管制的累積效應——管制把輝達擠出全球最大 AI 市場之一，也給中國本土供應商擴大規模的空間。這項表態對全球 AI 供應鏈具策略意義，意味親美陣營與中國本土加速器生態系正逐步分流。
items.summary_en: NVIDIA chief executive Jensen Huang has acknowledged that the company has effectively handed China's AI chip market to Huawei, saying "we have already exited that market." The remark reflects the cumulative impact of US export controls, which have squeezed NVIDIA out of one of the world's largest AI markets and given domestic Chinese suppliers room to scale. The admission carries strategic weight for the global AI supply chain, signalling a bifurcation between US-aligned and China-domestic accelerator ecosystems.

items.title_zh: 遠傳攜手亞馬遜 Amazon Leo 布局低軌衛星
items.title_en: FET partners with Amazon Leo for low-Earth-orbit connectivity
items.summary_zh: 遠傳電信與亞馬遜 Amazon Leo（前身為 Project Kuiper）簽署合作協議，推進低軌衛星網路服務，是台灣非地面通訊布局的一大進展。同業中華電信則表示樂見更多產業夥伴投入衛星市場，不過業界也指出，衛星直連手機服務「仍要再等等」。此合作有助台灣電信業者強化網路韌性與覆蓋——在海纜面臨地緣政治風險之下，這已是日益重要的策略課題。
items.summary_en: Far EasTone has signed a cooperation agreement with Amazon Leo (formerly Project Kuiper) to advance low-Earth-orbit satellite network services, marking a step forward in Taiwan's non-terrestrial connectivity ambitions. Rival Chunghwa Telecom welcomed more industry partners entering the satellite market, though the industry notes direct-to-cell phone services "still need more time." The deals position Taiwanese carriers to bolster network resilience and coverage — an increasingly strategic priority given geopolitical risks to undersea cables.

items.title_zh: 壽險業 Q1 保單利潤大增 累計達 2.5 兆元
items.title_en: Life insurers' Q1 contract service margin tops NT$2.5tn under IFRS 17
items.summary_zh: 台灣壽險業正式邁入 IFRS 17 新制時代，被會計師視為壽險業「未來長期獲利寶庫」的合約服務邊際（CSM，即保單利潤）成績單出爐。首季全體壽險業新契約 CSM 增加 1,137.2 億元，累計總額更高達 2 兆 5,000 億元，且六大業者就占近八成。此數據是會計制度大改後，市場首度清楚掌握壽險業「儲存的未來獲利」，也凸顯保單利潤火力高度集中於少數大型業者。
items.summary_en: With Taiwan's life insurance industry now operating under the new IFRS 17 regime, the closely watched contract service margin (CSM) — viewed by auditors as the sector's "future long-term profit reservoir" — has been disclosed. New-business CSM rose NT$113.72bn in the first quarter, lifting the industry-wide accumulated total to NT$2.5tn, with six major insurers accounting for nearly 80%. The figures offer the first clear read on stored future profitability under the accounting overhaul, and underscore the concentration of policy-profit firepower among the largest players.

items.title_zh: 國票金改選 公股徵求委託書拿下 9% 股權
items.title_en: Public-sector shares gain ground in IBT Financial board reshuffle
items.summary_zh: 國票金將於 5 月 29 日召開股東會並改選董事。財政部長莊翠雲透露，泛公股徵求委託書約取得 9% 股權，若公股金融事業取得經營主導權，後續人事布局備受關注。立法院財委會多位立委亦關切此次改選情況。此一進展顯示市場派與公股對國票金經營權的爭奪正逐步升溫。
items.summary_en: Ahead of IBT Financial Holding's shareholders' meeting and board election on 29 May, Finance Minister Chuang Tsui-yun disclosed that pro-government-share proxy solicitation has secured roughly 9% of voting rights. If public-sector financial entities gain operating control, subsequent personnel arrangements will draw close attention. Legislators on the Finance Committee questioned the contest in detail. The development signals an intensifying tussle for control of the holding company between market factions and the state.

items.title_zh: 第一金否認「公民併」傳聞 獲利反創新高
items.title_en: First Financial denies "public-private" merger rumour, reports record profit
items.summary_zh: 第一金 20 日表示，目前並無外界盛傳的「公民併」（公股與民營金控合併）規劃；至於四家公股金控投信整併案，仍在研議中。公司強調，投信業務占金控比重不到 1.5%，影響有限。相對地，本業獲利持續走強，4 月與前四月稅後純益同步改寫歷史新高。此番說明意在平息併購臆測，同時凸顯基本面表現。
items.summary_en: First Financial Holding said on 20 May it has no plans for the much-rumoured "public-private" (公民) merger, while a separate study of investment-trust integration among four state-owned financial holdings continues. The company stressed that investment-trust business accounts for less than 1.5% of group weighting, so any impact would be limited. By contrast, core banking earnings keep strengthening: after-tax profit for both April and the first four months hit record highs. The statement aims to calm speculation while highlighting fundamentals.

items.title_zh: 台新證 APP 再傳大規模當機 恐重演重複扣款
items.title_en: Taishin Securities app crashes again, raising double-billing fears
items.summary_zh: 台新證券交易 APP 21 日上午再度傳出大規模當機，部分投資人反映出現「重複扣款」問題。自台新證券與元富證券合併後，整併後的交易系統屢傳當機、出包，日前才因系統問題爆出 20 億元爭議款，並遭金管會關注、開罰。一再發生的系統故障，再度引發外界對該券商併購後系統整合與營運韌性的疑慮。
items.summary_en: Taishin Securities' trading app suffered another large-scale outage on the morning of 21 May, with some investors reporting duplicate charges. Since the merger of Taishin Securities and Masterlink Securities, the combined trading system has repeatedly crashed and thrown up bugs, including an earlier NT$2bn disputed-funds incident that drew regulatory attention and a fine from the Financial Supervisory Commission. The recurring failures raise fresh questions about post-merger system integration and operational resilience at the brokerage.

items.title_zh: 渣打集團擬四年內裁員 7,000 人 後台營運衝擊最大
items.title_en: Standard Chartered plans to cut 7,000 jobs over four years on AI adoption
items.summary_zh: 渣打集團計畫未來四年內裁員約 7,000 人，以加速採用人工智慧，其中後台營運中心受到的影響最大。此舉是全球銀行業整體撙節成本、提升效率的一環——AI 正日益自動化處理與支援性職能。此計畫再添一例佐證：AI 正重塑金融業的人力結構，尤其衝擊例行性的營運職位。
items.summary_en: Standard Chartered intends to cut about 7,000 jobs over the next four years as it accelerates the adoption of artificial intelligence, with back-office operations centres expected to be hit hardest. The move is part of a broader cost-and-efficiency drive across global banking, where AI is increasingly automating processing and support functions. The plan adds to mounting evidence that AI is reshaping financial-sector headcount, particularly for routine operational roles.

items.title_zh: 金管會放寬全權委託：接受高淨值投資法人委託 鬆綁運用限制
items.title_en: FSC eases discretionary-investment terms for professional and high-net-worth institutional clients
items.summary_zh: 金管會就全權委託投資業者接受「專業投資機構」或「高淨值投資法人」委託發布規範。當此類客戶委託並同意時，委託資產的運用限制相較一般散戶委託獲得鬆綁。此次釋示讓財富與資產管理業者在服務具專業能力的合格客戶時更具彈性，也呼應台灣依客戶專業程度差異化監理、推動財富管理 2.0 與打造亞洲資產管理中心的整體政策方向。
items.summary_en: The Financial Supervisory Commission has issued guidance for discretionary-investment operators that accept mandates from professional institutional investors or high-net-worth corporate investors. With the client's commission and consent, the rules governing the use of the entrusted assets are relaxed relative to those for general retail mandates. The clarification gives wealth and asset managers more flexibility when serving sophisticated, qualified clients, and aligns with Taiwan's broader drive to develop wealth-management 2.0 and an Asian asset-management hub by differentiating regulation by client sophistication.

items.title_zh: 臺銀「黃金王子」喊 4,500 美元是進場點
items.title_en: Bank of Taiwan's "Gold Prince" calls US$4,500 a buying point
items.summary_zh: 在臺灣銀行 127 週年行慶上，長年被稱為「黃金王子」的臺銀貴金屬部經理楊天立，現場獲象徵性升格為「黃金國王」。楊天立再度喊出每盎司 4,500 美元是黃金的進場點，並建議兩招「聰明淘金」策略。其談話反映在中東情勢緊張、債市波動與通膨不確定下，市場對黃金作為核心分散風險資產的信心不減——這正是高資產客戶資產配置的相關課題。
items.summary_en: At Bank of Taiwan's 127th-anniversary celebration, the bank's veteran precious-metals manager Yang Tien-li — long nicknamed the "Gold Prince" — was symbolically promoted on stage to "Gold King." Yang reiterated that US$4,500 an ounce is an entry point for gold and suggested two strategies for "smart" gold accumulation. His comments reflect continued institutional conviction in bullion as a core diversification asset amid Middle-East tensions, bond-market volatility and inflation uncertainty — themes directly relevant to high-net-worth portfolio allocation.

items.title_zh: 台灣人最怕負債 為何有錢人卻刻意保留貸款
items.title_en: Why the wealthy deliberately keep their loans
items.summary_zh: 一篇財富管理專題探討一道行為落差：許多台灣人對負債避之唯恐不及、急著還清借款，富裕家庭卻往往刻意保留貸款。文章指出，對高資產族群而言，低成本槓桿可保留流動性、讓資金續留於報酬較高的資產，並服務於資產傳承與稅務規劃，使「好的負債」成為工具而非負擔。此討論對顧問在整體財富與傳承規劃中重新框定客戶的槓桿觀念，是實用的參考。
items.summary_en: A wealth-management feature explores a behavioural divide: while many Taiwanese are debt-averse and rush to repay borrowings, affluent households often deliberately retain loans. The piece argues that, for high-net-worth individuals, low-cost leverage can preserve liquidity, keep capital invested in higher-returning assets and serve estate- and tax-planning purposes, making "good debt" a tool rather than a burden. The discussion is a useful reference for advisers reframing client attitudes toward leverage within holistic wealth and succession planning.

items.title_zh: 稅稅唸學堂：補報生前贈與＋申請 1030 條之 1 憲判加持獲 125 萬扣除額
items.title_en: Tax column: late-reported gift plus Article 1030-1 claim yields NT$1.25m deduction via constitutional ruling
items.summary_zh: 經濟日報「稅稅唸學堂」專欄詳述一則遺產稅案例：一名納稅人補報父親生前贈與，並主張民法第 1030 條之 1 的配偶剩餘財產差額分配請求權，意外搭上近期憲法法庭裁判的「便車」，多獲得 125 萬元扣除額，當事人卻不領情。此案凸顯生前贈與補報、可自遺產稅扣除的配偶剩餘財產請求權，以及憲法解釋變動三者之間的技術性交互作用，對傳承規劃顧問是實用的提醒。
items.summary_en: A tax-education column details an estate-tax case in which a taxpayer who supplementarily reported her late father's lifetime gift and invoked the Civil Code's Article 1030-1 spousal remainder-distribution claim ended up benefiting from a recent Constitutional Court ruling, gaining an additional NT$1.25m deduction — yet remained dissatisfied with the outcome. The case highlights the technical interplay between gift-tax back-reporting, the spousal remainder claim deductible from estate tax, and shifting constitutional interpretation, and serves as a practical reminder for succession-planning advisers.

items.title_zh: 繼承父母土地、夫妻贈與要當心 漏報地價稅五倍起跳
items.title_en: Land-tax rate can jump fivefold after inheritance or spousal gift, tax bureau warns
items.summary_zh: 台中稅務局提醒，土地經繼承、贈與、買賣，甚至夫妻間贈與而導致所有權人變更時，原本適用的自用住宅用地稅率（千分之 2）不會自動延續。所有權一旦移轉，新所有權人必須重新申請自用住宅用地稅率；若漏未申請，即使房屋用途與戶籍都沒有改變，土地仍會按一般稅率課徵——稅額五倍起跳。此提醒對處理不動產傳承的家庭是一項實用的警示。
items.summary_en: The Taichung Local Tax Bureau is reminding the public that the preferential self-use residential land-tax rate of 0.2% does not automatically carry over when land changes hands through inheritance, gift, sale or even a gift between spouses. Once ownership transfers, the new owner must re-apply for the self-use rate; failing to do so can see the land taxed at the general rate — five times higher or more — even if the building's use and household registration are unchanged. The reminder is a practical caution for families handling property succession.

items.title_zh: 賴清德宣布 0 至 18 歲每月 5,000 元成長津貼
items.title_en: Lai unveils NT$5,000 monthly child allowance for ages 0–18
items.summary_zh: 為因應少子女化危機並適逢就職兩週年，賴清德總統宣布推出 0 至 18 歲成長津貼，每名兒童每月 5,000 元，每年預算規模約 2,000 億元。行政院規劃最快明年上路，且不排富：0 至 6 歲由家長全額支用，6 歲後半數存入「未來基金」，滿 18 歲時每名兒童可有 36 萬元。分析也點出財政壓力——2026 年總預算案已差短 1,727 億元。
items.summary_en: Marking his second anniversary in office and responding to Taiwan's low-birth-rate crisis, President Lai Ching-te announced a growth allowance of NT$5,000 a month for every child aged 0 to 18, with an annual budget of about NT$2tn. The Executive Yuan plans to launch it as early as next year, with no means-testing: the full amount goes to parents for ages 0–6, while half is saved into a "future fund" after age 6, giving each child NT$360,000 on reaching 18. Analysts flagged the fiscal strain, noting the 2026 budget already shows a NT$172.7bn shortfall.

items.title_zh: 賴清德提千億元振興中小微傳統產業計畫
items.title_en: Lai pledges NT$100bn revitalisation plan for small and traditional businesses
items.summary_zh: 賴清德總統表示，政府將提出 1,000 億元「中小微傳統產業加速振興計畫」，執行期間約八年，要讓科技產業以「生態系」方式帶動傳統產業向前。談及能源，賴總統說，面對經濟發展與 AI 用電需求，政府將務實評估各種能源選項。這些政策意在推動台灣成長動能擴及半導體之外，並因應傳統產業面臨的結構性挑戰。
items.summary_en: President Lai said the government will launch a NT$100bn "acceleration plan to revitalise small, micro and traditional industries," running for about eight years, with the aim of having the tech sector pull traditional industries forward through an "ecosystem" approach. On energy, Lai said the government will pragmatically evaluate all options as it weighs economic growth and AI-driven electricity demand. The proposals signal a policy push to broaden Taiwan's growth beyond semiconductors and to address structural challenges facing legacy sectors.

items.title_zh: 4 月外銷訂單衝上 874 億美元 年增 48% 連 15 紅
items.title_en: April export orders surge 48% to record US$87.4bn — 15th straight monthly gain
items.summary_zh: 台灣 4 月外銷訂單衝上 874 億美元，年增 48%，創歷年同月新高，並把年增紀錄延伸至連續 15 個月成長。此一亮眼數據反映 AI 伺服器、先進晶片及相關硬體需求強勁不墜，持續驅動台灣出口引擎。數據強化市場對製造動能與科技業獲利樂觀的預期，但也凸顯台灣經濟對 AI 投資循環的依賴正持續加深。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's April export orders climbed to US$87.4bn, up 48% year-on-year and the strongest April on record, extending the streak of annual gains to 15 consecutive months. The blowout reading reflects relentless demand for AI servers, advanced chips and related hardware that continues to power Taiwan's export engine. The data reinforce expectations of robust manufacturing momentum and tech-sector earnings, though they also highlight the economy's deepening reliance on the AI investment cycle.

items.title_zh: 央行不排除上修 CPI 增幅 利率走向下月分曉
items.title_en: Central bank may revise up CPI forecast as oil risk builds
items.summary_zh: 中東地緣政治風險升溫、國際油價波動加劇，中央銀行副總裁嚴宗大表示，若國際原油價格持續攀升，不排除再度上修今年消費者物價指數（CPI）年增率預測值。外界高度關注央行是否將轉向升息，政策方向將於下月理監事會議更趨明朗。此番談話為台灣的通膨與利率展望再添不確定性。
items.summary_en: With Middle-East geopolitical risk intensifying and international oil prices increasingly volatile, Taiwan's central bank deputy governor Yen Tsung-ta said that if crude prices keep climbing, the bank may again revise up its 2026 forecast for the consumer price index. Markets are watching closely for whether the central bank could move toward a rate hike, with the policy direction set to become clearer at next month's board meeting. The comments inject fresh uncertainty into Taiwan's inflation and rate outlook.

items.title_zh: 第 1 季國際收支連二季逆差
items.title_en: Taiwan's balance of payments posts second straight quarterly deficit
items.summary_zh: 根據央行統計，台灣第 1 季國際收支呈現逆差，為連續第二季出現赤字。連二季逆差反映在匯率波動與央行近期進場穩定新台幣的背景下，跨境資金流向（含對外投資與證券資金移動）正在轉變。儘管台灣外銷訂單暢旺，這項數據仍值得關注，可作為觀察外部部門壓力的指標。
items.summary_en: Taiwan recorded a balance-of-payments deficit in the first quarter, the second consecutive quarterly shortfall, according to central bank data. The back-to-back deficits reflect shifting cross-border capital flows — including outbound investment and portfolio movements — against a backdrop of currency volatility and the central bank's recent intervention to stabilise the New Taiwan dollar. The figures bear watching as an indicator of external-sector pressures, even as Taiwan's export orders boom.

items.title_zh: 輝達 Q1 財報超預期 盤後股價卻小跌
items.title_en: NVIDIA beats Q1 estimates but shares slip after-hours
items.summary_zh: 輝達公布第一財季（2027 財年）營收達 816 億美元，優於市場預期，營收與獲利雙雙強勁成長。在財報電話會議上，管理層形容 AI 基礎建設正處於「人類史上最大規模基礎設施擴張」，需求正從訓練向推理轉移。執行長黃仁勳指出 GB300 與 Rubin 系統供不應求、利潤大幅躍升。然而盤後股價仍跌逾 1%——儘管財報優於預期，投資人焦點已轉向競爭與 AI 成長的下一階段，並質疑華爾街的胃口是否已過熱。
items.summary_en: NVIDIA reported first-quarter (FY2027) revenue of US$81.6bn, beating market expectations, with both revenue and profit posting strong growth. On its earnings call, management framed AI infrastructure as undergoing "the largest infrastructure expansion in human history," with demand shifting from training toward inference. CEO Jensen Huang said GB300 and Rubin systems are in short supply and that profit jumped sharply. Yet shares fell more than 1% after-hours as investors, despite the beat, shifted focus to competition and the next phase of AI growth — questioning whether Wall Street's expectations had simply run too hot.

items.title_zh: 亞洲科技股強勁反彈創六週新高 韓股 KOSPI 大漲 7%
items.title_en: Asian tech stocks rebound hardest in six weeks; KOSPI soars 7%
items.summary_zh: 亞洲股市周四強勁反彈，科技股漲幅創近六週新高，受隔夜美股回升與 AI 需求強韌帶動。日韓股市領漲：南韓 KOSPI 大漲約 7%，SK 海力士早盤飆逾 11%、LG 狂升 25%。野村證券轉趨樂觀，預估 KOSPI 今年有望衝上 11,000 點。這波全面性上漲，顯示區域內以科技股為主的指數風險偏好迅速回溫。
items.summary_en: Asian equities rallied sharply on Thursday, with technology stocks posting their biggest gain in nearly six weeks, lifted by an overnight recovery on Wall Street and resilient AI demand. Japanese and Korean markets led the rebound: South Korea's KOSPI jumped about 7%, with SK Hynix surging more than 11% and LG soaring 25% in early trade. Nomura turned bullish, projecting the KOSPI could reach 11,000 this year. The broad-based advance signals a swift restoration of risk appetite across the region's tech-heavy indices.

items.title_zh: 全球債市同步崩盤 美 30 年期公債殖利率逼近 5.2%
items.title_en: Global bond markets sell off in tandem as 30-year US yield nears 5.2%
items.summary_zh: 自 5 月中旬以來，主要已開發國家公債同步遭拋售，殖利率罕見地同步飆高。美國 30 年期公債殖利率周二一度衝上 5.18%，創 2007 至 08 年金融海嘯前夕以來最高。美國銀行警告，5% 防線失守後，通往「厄運之門」已打開，並稱 6 月是減碼的最佳逃命窗口。全球債市同時重挫，反映財政可持續性疑慮與通膨風險，對投資組合與風險性資產構成關鍵風險。
items.summary_en: Major developed-market government bonds have sold off together since mid-May, with yields spiking in a rare synchronised move. The US 30-year Treasury yield touched 5.18% on Tuesday, its highest since just before the 2007–08 financial crisis. Bank of America has warned that, with the 5% line breached, a "doorway to doom" has opened, calling June the best window to cut exposure. The simultaneous global rout reflects fiscal-sustainability worries and inflation risk, and poses a key risk to portfolios and risk assets.

items.title_zh: 美國原油庫存創史上最大降幅 供應壓力升高
items.title_en: US crude inventories post record drawdown as supply pressure mounts
items.summary_zh: 美國原油庫存以史上最快速度下滑，全球庫存每日蒸發約 870 萬桶。在伊朗衝突使荷姆茲海峽幾近封鎖之際，美國正迅速成為全球替代原油供應核心；出口暴增與戰略儲油持續釋出，正快速消耗其供應緩衝。分析師警告供應恐緊俏至 10 月，美國夏季汽油每加侖價格恐突破 5 美元、創近四年新高，在用油旺季開跑之際擠壓消費者荷包。
items.summary_en: US crude oil inventories have fallen at their fastest pace on record, with global stocks plunging by roughly 8.7m barrels a day. With the Strait of Hormuz nearly blockaded amid the Iran conflict, the United States is rapidly becoming a core alternative supplier; surging exports and continued strategic-reserve releases are eroding its supply buffer. Analysts warn supply could stay tight into October, and that US gasoline could top US$5 a gallon this summer — a near-four-year high — squeezing consumers as the driving season begins.

items.title_zh: 歐盟達成初步協議 擬取消部分美國商品關稅
items.title_en: EU strikes preliminary deal to scrap some tariffs on US goods
items.summary_zh: 歐盟周三就一項關鍵法案達成初步協議，將取消對部分美國商品的進口關稅。此舉是落實去年 7 月與華府達成的跨大西洋貿易協議的重要一步，目的在避免美國對歐盟產品課徵更高的報復性關稅。此進展象徵跨大西洋貿易緊張趨於緩和，為雙邊出口商帶來一定程度的喘息，也減少籠罩全球貿易的一項不確定來源。
items.summary_en: The European Union reached a preliminary agreement on Wednesday on a key piece of legislation to remove import tariffs on certain US goods. The step implements the transatlantic trade deal struck with Washington last July and aims to head off higher retaliatory US tariffs on EU products. The move signals a de-escalation in transatlantic trade tensions, offering a measure of relief to exporters on both sides and reducing one source of uncertainty hanging over global trade.

items.title_zh: 戴蒙示警利率恐更高 Fed 會議紀錄多數官員主張將升息列入選項
items.title_en: Dimon warns rates could go higher as Fed minutes float hike option
items.summary_zh: 摩根大通執行長戴蒙警告，利率還可能進一步走高。另外，最新一次聯準會會議紀錄顯示，多數官員主張將升息保留為政策選項之一。兩相對照顯示，儘管市場期待寬鬆，利率向上的風險依然存在——背後是僵固的通膨與重新升溫的能源價格壓力——對股市與債市投資人都是須留意的警訊。
items.summary_en: JPMorgan chief executive Jamie Dimon has warned that interest rates could rise further. Separately, minutes from the latest Federal Reserve meeting showed that most officials favoured keeping a rate hike among the policy options on the table. The combination signals that, despite market hopes for easing, the upside risk to rates remains live — driven by sticky inflation and renewed energy-price pressure — a cautionary backdrop for equity and bond investors alike.
